requests: One request per asset, all three requests in a single parallel batch. No variants or retries.

assets.name: hero
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: luxury Brazilian barbershop homepage hero photograph
Primary request: Original cinematic photograph of an intimate private-club barbershop interior, with an authentic black leather classic barber chair placed center-right, dark walnut paneling, antique brass large mirrors and warm wall sconces, subtle daylight.
Style/medium: Photographic realism, luxury editorial interiors photography, original conceptual interior.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2; generous darker left area as natural negative space for HTML text placed later, photograph contains no text. Camera at human eye height.
Lighting/mood: Restrained warm dramatic light, intimate, believable reflections.
Color palette: Black, espresso, aged brass; cohesive warm muted color treatment.
Materials/textures: Tactile worn leather, real dark walnut grain, subtly aged metal.
Constraints: No people, no text, no logos, no watermarks. This is an original conceptual interior, not documentation of any actual business. Create exactly one image.
